sections.heading: Description
lines: Factory Field is one of the Field Effects present in Rejuvenation. It is classified as a Synthetic field and can be found in the Xen Battleship during the battle against Melia, in the Xen Battleships of Route 6 and during the Bladestar Gauntlet.

sections.heading: Transitions From Other Fields
lines: Short-Circuit Field will transform into this field if the moves Aura Wheel, Charge Beam, Discharge, Ion Deluge, Overdrive, Parabolic Charge, Super U.M.D. Move (Special attack), Wild Charge, or the Z-Move Gigavolt Havoc are used once, of if the move Tidy Up is used twice.
“SYSTEM ONLINE.”
“Some junk was cleaned up!”
Aura Wheel, Discharge, Gigavolt Havoc, Ion Deluge, Overdrive & Super U.M.D. Move also change Factory Field back to Short-Circuit Field, allowing to alternate between both fields.

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Electric-type moves → 1.2x boost.
“The attack took energy from the field!”
As of V14.0.22, the in-game Field Notes incorrectly state that the boost is 1.5x.

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Buffed Abilities:
Defragment raises Defense or Special Defense by 2 stages on activation.
Download raises Attack or Special Attack by 2 stages on activation.
Galvanize increases base power by 1.5x for affected moves instead of 1.2x.
Light Metal raises the bearer's Speed by 1 stage on switch-in.
“[Pokémon]'s light body makes it nimble!”
Motor Drive raises Speed by 2 stages on activation.
Steelworker increases the power of affected moves by 2x instead of 1.5x.
Technician applies to moves of up to 80 base power.
This also applies to the Dusknoir Crest.
Other Ability Changes:
Gulp Missile will always pick up Pikachu.
Heavy Metal raises the bearer's Defense by 1 stage and lowers their Speed by 1 stage on switch-in.
“[Pokémon]'s heavy body is sturdy and unmoving!”

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Damage Modifiers: Moves which receive an attack buff:
Double Iron Bash, Flash Cannon, Gear Grind, Gyro Ball, Magnet Bomb → 2x boost.
“ATTACK SEQUENCE INITIATE.”
Spin Out, Steamroller, Super U.M.D. Move, Techno Blast → 1.5x boost.
“ATTACK SEQUENCE UPDATE.”
Other moves: Buffed Moves:
Autotomize raises the user's Speed by 3 stages.
Gear Up raises the Attack and Special Attack of any affected Pokémon by 2 stages.
Iron Defense raises the user's Defense by 3 stages.
Magnet Rise lasts for 8 turns.
Metal Sound lowers the target's Special Defense by 3 stages.
Shift Gear raises the user's Attack and Speed by 2 stages.
Steel Beam's recoil is lowered to 25% Max HP.
Field-dependent moves & Abilities:
Mimicry changes the bearer's type to Steel.
Camouflage changes the user's type to Steel.
Nature Power becomes Gear Grind.
Secret Power may lower Attack.
Shelter halves damage from Steel-type moves.
Terrain Pulse's type becomes Steel.

sections.heading: Transitions to Other Fields
lines: Any move in this section inherently gains a 1.3x damage boost on top of any other previously listed modifiers.

This field will transform into Short-Circuit Field if the moves Aura Wheel, Bulldoze, Discharge, Earthquake, Explosion, Fissure, Ion Deluge, Magnitude, Overdrive, Self-Destruct, Super U.M.D. Move (Physical attack), or the the Z-Moves Gigavolt Havoc, Light That Burns the Sky or Tectonic Rage are used.
“The field shorted out!”
“The field was broken!”
“All the light was consumed!”
Aura Wheel, Discharge, Gigavolt Havoc, Ion Deluge, Overdrive & Super U.M.D. Move also change Short-Circuit Field back to Factory Field, allowing to alternate between both fields.

sections.heading: Items
lines: Synthetic Seed raises Special Attack by 1 stage and applies Laser Focus to the user for 2 turns.

sections.heading: Notes
lines: Prior to V14, Discharge & Overdrive changed the field once for every Pokémon hit.
